statement: Under the full joint twisted-swap algebra promise, the rectangular16x9 defect T-J has the same kernel in every current conditional memory state. body: Trusted controls/private permanently retired keys/isolated endpoint storage are actual resources. Learning requires a common joint algebra and excitation; guard soundness does not certify that model or ensure availability. The1/128 bound is accepted-subnormalized, not normalized fidelity for every accepted run. No hardware, generic noise-learning solution, total-cost advantage or priority established. Read the exact supporting statement and its applicable conditions.
